initial.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a new ultra-polished desktop SaaS product screenshot for AdaptOps, based on the supplied images ONLY as visual style references. New composition, preserve the established visual language: Inter typography, ink #142036, white surfaces, pale cool gray #f4f7f9, deep teal #145c68 actions, thin #e2e9ee borders, restrained amber attention and green opportunity. Flat, precise, quietly confident enterprise software. Excellent optical alignment, thoughtful typography, functional density and whitespace. Canvas approximately 1600 x 1000, entire application visible, front-on, crisp readable UI. No device frame.
Shared shell in ALL variants: slim top header with AdaptOps, workspace "Demo Materials", "22 Oct 2026", Paul avatar. Left sidebar 190px, labels "Overview" selected, "Watchtower", "Actions", "Company", "Data & Connections". Small visible label at upper right inside header "A · Design proposal". Small footer "Synthetic company data · Controlled demo event". English only.
Same business facts and same content scope in all variants:
Overview title "Your operations, in focus." Small subline "What changed. What it means. What to do next."
A modest company-context line "Materials distribution · Lille / Central / South".
A compact summary of "Needs attention" count 1, "Opportunity to qualify" count 1, "Awaiting review" count 1. These are prototype dossier counts, never financial metrics.
Watchtower recent activity list, each row with source, time, precise short status:
"10:32" "Inbound delivery rescheduled" source "ERP simulation", badge "Needs attention". This is the selected CONTROLLED DEMO EVENT, never a public article.
"10:28" "Additional demand received" source "CRM simulation", badge "To qualify".
"10:14" "ROCKWOOL capacity announcement" source "Public source · Historical context", badge "Context only". Public news is not evidence of the delivery delay.
Selected dossier uses explicit information hierarchy:
"Delivery update" small eyebrow, headline "Protect Site A without disrupting Site B".
A short three-step evidence trail: "Delivery date changed" → "Site A exposed" → "Review purchase option".
Key facts: "Site A" "8 ISO100 pallets · 23 Oct" badge "At risk"; "Site B" badge "Reservation protected".
Proposed response: "Emergency purchase" and "€1,420" caption "Proposed cost". This is cost, never savings or revenue. Alternative "Transfer" caption "Conditional on replenishment".
One primary CTA "Review plan"; a secondary text link "Sources & calculations".
Contextual assistant affordance labelled "Ask AdaptOps" with example "Where do we stand on this delivery?" It should feel like part of this business workspace, grounded in the selected dossier.
Source freshness near feed "Last collection 10:32" plus "View sources", NOT a fake continuously-live stock ticker.
Avoid: marketing website, giant hero, gradients, glow, glassmorphism, blue-purple AI palette, sparkles, robot avatars, decorative graphs, charts without facts, oversized round cards, ocean of pills, huge numbers, invented ROI, invented customer names, endless text, illegible tiny typography, lorem ipsum, excessive panels, technical implementation labels. No em dash characters. Quality comparable to exceptionally well-crafted professional operational software.

Composition A: OVERVIEW WITH ACTIVITY RAIL. Calm, crisp overview dashboard with a small 3-item summary row, substantial main selected-impact panel and a narrower right Watchtower activity column. Within the main panel arrange the change, impact, and proposed response as a clear left-to-right narrative with concise rows and a small option section. Chat is a slim contextual input bar anchored beneath the selected dossier, not a large empty chat panel. The Watchtower rail contains the three feed items and source freshness. Show distinctive editorial hierarchy; every item feels real and useful. Large action has priority, not the price. Let the selected new feed row have a subtle teal leading edge.
